description: This source file defines the 'WrappedException' class in the Orleans runtime, a custom serializable exception that extends OrleansException. It includes constructors, serialization support, and static methods for creating and rethrowing exceptions with preserved stack traces.

classes.name: WrappedException
classes.description: A custom exception class used within Orleans to wrap and rethrow exceptions with preserved stack traces, serializable, and providing additional context on the original exception type.

methods.name: WrappedException(string message)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specified message.

methods.name: WrappedException(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
methods.description: Obsolete constructor used for deserialization, reconstructs the exception from serialized data.

methods.name: GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
methods.description: Serializes additional data, specifically the original exception type.

methods.name: CreateAndRethrow(Exception exception)
methods.description: Creates a new WrappedException from an existing exception and rethrows it, preserving the stack trace.

methods.name: CreateFromException(Exception exception)
methods.description: Helper method that creates a WrappedException from an arbitrary exception, including formatting the exception details and stack trace.

methods.name: ToString()
methods.description: Overrides ToString to include the original exception type and message.
